title: Woodpiles in real wood
items: Woodpiles, chopping blocks, log heaps and loose billets now wear a photographic wood surface: split ends with rings, bark rinds and checks, bark along the sticks, sawn rounds with axe scores.
1812 water casks and trade casks carry the same wood grain as the town's other casks.
1812 woodpiles now show on phones too.
